benchmark_metadata.name: Legal Contract Analyzer Benchmark Suite
benchmark_metadata.description: Curated legal domain evaluation queries mapped to exact ground-truth clause IDs across Enterprise SaaS and Consulting agreements.

queries.question: Can the customer terminate the agreement early for convenience without penalty?
queries.notes: Section 4 prohibits termination for convenience and imposes 100% liquidated damages.

queries.question: Are there any post-termination non-compete restrictions, and what is their duration and geographic scope?
queries.notes: Section 9 imposes a 24-month worldwide restriction on developing similar software.

queries.question: What is the maximum aggregate liability cap for the vendor?
queries.notes: Section 8 caps vendor liability to $50 or fees paid in the single preceding month.

queries.question: Does the vendor have the right to use customer data to train machine learning models?
queries.notes: Section 5 grants vendor perpetual worldwide license to ingest customer data for ML training.

queries.question: Does the contract automatically renew, and what is the required notice window for non-renewal?
queries.notes: Section 3 establishes evergreen 12-month renewals with 90-day certified mail notice.

queries.question: Who is required to indemnify whom for third-party intellectual property claims?
queries.notes: Section 7 is unilateral: customer indemnifies vendor for IP infringement.

queries.question: Can either party terminate this consulting agreement for convenience?
queries.notes: Section 3 allows mutual termination for convenience on 30 days written notice.

queries.question: Who owns custom software code and designs created specifically for the client?
queries.notes: Section 4 transfers ownership of deliverables to Client upon full payment.

queries.question: How is the limitation of liability calculated for consulting services?
queries.notes: Section 7 caps mutual liability at total aggregate fees paid in preceding 12 months.

queries.question: What are the restrictions on hiring or soliciting the consultant's personnel?
queries.notes: Section 8 specifies 12-month mutual non-solicitation, excluding general job postings.

queries.question: What are the payment terms and invoicing schedule (e.g. Net 30)?
queries.notes: Section 2 provides Net 30 payment terms and 10-day notice for billing disputes.

queries.question: Is indemnification mutual or one-sided in this consulting agreement?
queries.notes: Section 6 establishes mutual indemnification for gross negligence and breach.
